assumptions: The selected Rust, linker, Node, Nix, immutable engine/vendor closures and this driver are trusted build tooling.
Source snapshots and Cargo artifact transcripts bind this build; neither a hash nor a successful compilation proves compiler correctness.
non_claims: proof extraction or Nix check execution

wasi.stable_0_3_0: rejected at link; not silently substituted

driver.kind: single-thread cooperative engine with bounded external blocking workers
driver.task_exit: explicitly awaited before successful export observation
driver.cancellation: logical production-table revocation; invocation-isolated Store destruction; native pins retained externally until actual native stop
driver.stream_buffer: one byte engine producer buffer; 64-byte bounded consumer payload; terminal outcome separate from read-end closure

live_payload_reservations.scope: payload storage only; engine, task metadata and bounded worker thread stacks are not whole-process heap accounting

non_claims: all Component-Draft or all WASI interfaces
Wasmtime per-task cancellation API (not provided in40.0.2)
general guest task scheduler or spawn/channel language
universal Canonical ABI, engine, OS scheduling or physical native resource proof
